task.description:
Validate that API-04 is ready for release.

Check:
1. zig build exits 0
2. zig build test exits 0
3. All MUST acceptance criteria in the API-04 requirement section are met by the implementation
4. tests/reports/API-04-test-report.md shows PASS

Write a release decision PASS or FAIL. If PASS, set result.status = PASS. If FAIL, list which acceptance criteria are not met.
acceptance_criteria: All API-04 MUST acceptance criteria verified in src/api/routes/tasks.zig

result.summary: API-04 release validation passed. zig build exits 0, zig build test exits 0 (12 passed, 12 skipped, 0 failed). All MUST acceptance criteria verified in src/api/routes/tasks.zig: GET /tasks with pagination and role-based row filtering (TASK_WORKER restricted to own tasks), GET /tasks/:id returning all required fields with 404 for not found, POST /tasks/:id/complete with output_variables validation and 409 for already-terminated, POST /tasks/:id/assign with PROCESS_OPERATOR role check and 409 for already-assigned, POST /tasks/:id/reassign with PROCESS_OPERATOR role check. Edge cases verified: 403 for TASK_WORKER completing another user's task, 409 for cancelled task. Test report tests/reports/API-04-test-report.md shows PASS.
